entities.summary: The Ferrocarril Chihuahua al Pacífico, commonly known as the Chepe Express or El Chepe, is a passenger train operated by Ferromex in northwestern Mexico between city of Chihuahua and Los Mochis, crosses the Sierra Madre Occidental mountain range.
